intro.h2: A remodel you can follow from start date to cleanup
paragraphs: Bancroft Kitchen & Bath handles kitchen and bath remodeling in Yorktown, VA, from quartz countertops and tile backsplash to full bathroom renovations. What clients mention most is the organization: start dates that hold, a production schedule notebook when the job begins, and updates every week.

That structure holds up in tough settings. One client lives in a high rise condo where work can't start before 8:30 AM and has to end by 5 PM, and says the crew always started on time and cleaned up each day. Another needed an Outer Banks kitchen finished before his first renters arrived, and Gerald and Haley kept him updated with photos and texts the whole time.

services.h2: Kitchen and bath work we handle

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen remodels and updates, planned around your dates. One Outer Banks owner says Bancroft had everything he needed and went above and beyond to finish his kitchen before his first renters arrived. His family has used Bancroft on three local jobs and two in the Outer Banks.

image.alt: Oak kitchen with a granite island, tile backsplash, glass-front cabinet and a stained glass pendant over the table

items.name: Quartz and granite countertops
items.blurb: Gerald comes to your home to measure, give advice and bring samples, so you can choose the stone and color with confidence. Our installers set the countertops and leave the kitchen clean and tidy. We also replace countertops on their own, as we did for a condo client.

image.alt: Large granite island with a built-in cooktop, stainless island hood and charcoal cabinets

items.name: Tile backsplash
items.blurb: A new backsplash ties the countertop to the cabinets. We help you pick a tile and color that suit your quartz or granite, then our tile installers finish the job. One client says the countertop and tile installers did a great job and were pleasant to work with.

image.alt: Cherry kitchen with granite counters and a light tile backsplash under the wall cabinets

items.name: Bathroom renovations
items.blurb: We renovate bathrooms with the same start dates and weekly updates we use for kitchens. One condo owner had two bathrooms renovated by Bancroft and says the employees were considerate and talented and cleaned up after each day.

about.text: Bancroft Kitchen & Bath is a kitchen and bath contractor with a showroom in the York Square Shopping Center at 6605 George Washington Memorial Hwy in Yorktown. Most clients work with Gerald and Haley. Gerald visits to measure, advise and bring samples, and together they keep clients updated with photos and texts while the work goes on. Our own employees work alongside subcontractors that one reviewer called exceptional. That same client wrote that you can probably find contractors who charge less, but he did not believe they could provide the same quality, and he felt his work was reasonably priced.

items.name: Robert N.
items.text:
We've had Bancroft K&B renovate two bathrooms, replace flooring and baseboards, replace kitchen counter tops and fabricate an electric fireplace. We live in a high rise condo with many restrictions. No work before 8.30 AM, out by 5 PM.
Bancroft gave us start dates and always started on time. Upon start, the customer is provided with a production schedule notebook and updates each week. Employees are considerate, talented and clean up after each day. Their subcontractors are also exceptional.
I'm sure you can find numerous contractors that will do the renovations for less, but I don't believe they can provide the quality. I do believe our work was reasonably priced.

items.name: Kathy T.
items.text: From start to finish, Gerald and Haley made our kitchen update a success!! Their professionalism and expert advice guided us through materials and color selection of quartz countertops and tile backsplash. Gerald's visits to our home to measure, advise, provide suggestions and samples convinced us that Bancroft would be a company we could trust to do the job well. The countertop and tile installers did a great job, were pleasant to work with and left our kitchen clean and tidy as they completed their jobs! We love our updated kitchen and without hesitation will recommend Bancroft to others!

items.name: Lloyd J.
items.text: Bancroft saved the day on my kitchen remodel in the OBX.  They had everything I needed and went above and beyond to get my kitchen job completed in time for the arrival of my first renters.  Gerald and Haley were so wonderful to work with and kept me updated with photos and texts the whole time.  My family has used Bancroft on 3local and 2 OBX jobs and they’ve never let us down.  We now have beautiful kitchens and highly recommend them to all.

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Yorktown, VA and the Outer Banks
service_area.text: Our showroom is at 6605 George Washington Memorial Hwy in Yorktown, Virginia, and we take on kitchen and bath projects in and around Yorktown. We have also remodeled kitchens in the Outer Banks of North Carolina, including one for a client who rents his home there. If you are not sure whether your project is in range, call (757) 988-1100, or stop by the showroom on a weekday between 8 AM and 4 PM to talk it through.

items.a: Kitchens and bathrooms. That includes quartz and granite countertops, tile backsplash, full bathroom renovations, flooring and baseboards. For one condo client we also fabricated an electric fireplace. If your project is something else, call (757) 988-1100 and ask whether it is a fit.

items.q: How will I know what is happening on my job?
items.a: You get a start date before work begins and a production schedule notebook when the job starts, with updates each week. If you can't be on site, as with an Outer Banks rental, Gerald and Haley can keep you updated with photos and texts.

items.q: Can you work in a condo with building rules?
items.a: Yes. One client lives in a high rise condo where no work is allowed before 8:30 AM and everyone must be out by 5 PM. That client says Bancroft always started on time and cleaned up after each day, across two bathrooms, floors, counters and a fireplace.

items.q: Where are you and when are you open?
items.a: We are at 6605 George Washington Memorial Hwy, Yorktown, VA 23692. Hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM, and we are closed on weekends. Call (757) 988-1100 or email haley@bancroftgranite.com to set up a visit. You can also stop by the showroom during those hours.

items.q: How much will my project cost?
items.a: We don't publish set prices, because every kitchen and bathroom is different. Call or visit the showroom to set up a home visit and get an estimate for your project. One client wrote that you can find contractors who charge less, but he did not believe they could provide the quality, and that his work was reasonably priced.
